generate_midi_from_audio: generate MIDI token IDs from audio features using Pop2PianoForConditionalGeneration with composer conditioning
run_encoder_decoder_forward: run the encoder-decoder forward pass of Pop2PianoForConditionalGeneration to compute loss and logits for training
get_mel_conditioner_outputs: get mel conditioner outputs to concatenate composer-specific tokens at the front of input features
build_encoder_decoder_stack: build a Pop2PianoStack encoder or decoder with configurable layers, attention, and relative position bias
test_relative_attention_bias: test Pop2PianoAttention with relative position buckets and bidirectional or causal masking
